Mia (partnerships): Quick flag — HW partner (Lena) has asked for a coordinated private-offer tied to a 12mo commit. They want a joint announcement + SI enablement. Can ops/sales/product align on SKU+credit model?
Oliver (sales): Agree, we should avoid a huge headline discount. Proposal: tiered commit credits that phase in (Q1 small, Q2 ramp). Keeps list price intact for renewals.
Samantha (product): We can map private-offer to a dedicated SKU + promo code. Question: do we create separate SKUs per tier or one SKU with metadata?
Raj (engineering): From marketplace infra, separate SKUs are easier for billing/metrics but more overhead. Single SKU + `commit_tier` tag works if analytics hooks are okay.
Lena (HW Partner): Prefer single SKU for buyer simplicity, but want the UI to show "HW bundle credit applied". Also need co-branded announcement assets and an SI training deck.
Mia: OK — action items: (1) sales to confirm commit tiers and floor (Oliver), (2) product to decide SKU vs tag (Samantha), (3) eng to validate analytics path and promo mechanics (Raj), (4) partner to draft announcement timeline and SI enablement ask (Lena).
Oliver (sales): Commit tiers suggested: $100k, $300k, $750k over 12mo with 5%/10%/15% effective credit on marketplace consumption. Renewals should default back to list unless re-negotiated.
Samantha (product): For renewals we can attach a 30d notice to opt into renewal discounts. Also recommend a "top-up" credit flow if they exceed commit early.
Raj (engineering): Tech notes: need private offer fields: `commit_tier`, `hw_credit_pct`, `si_enablement_flag`. ETA to support in UI + billing: 3 sprints. I can prototype a webhook for partner events.
Lena (HW Partner): Can we lock in announcement week of May 18? SI partner training two weeks prior. We'll supply assets and a co-host for the webinar.
Mia: Sounds good. One more ask from legal: can we ensure auto-apply of HW credits only after redemption to prevent double-dipping with other promos? Legal asked for that control.
Oliver (sales): That makes sense. Sales to add a clause: "HW bundle credits apply once private-offer redemption is validated; cannot be stacked with marketplace promotional credits." 
marketplace-bot: New private-offer draft created: https://console.redwood.ai/private-offers/alpha-2026 (template id: PO-2026-042). Please review.
Samantha (product): I'll take SKU vs tag decision today and post an update. If eng needs a schema, ping me.
Raj (engineering): I'll prototype webhook and post the sample payload here by EOD.
Mia: Thanks team — I'll put these actions into the CRM and schedule a 30-min sync for Monday. :thumbsup:
